champion.tips: CHO'GATH TIPS AND TRICKS Use your Q slightly behind the enemy rather than on their current location to make it harder for them to dodge it. Wait for the marker before pressing your Ultimate R . Don’t use it unless the marker appears. Whenever your Q or W is up, don’t automatically use either one of them unless you’re certain that the enemy isn’t a threat to you. Otherwise, the enemy may wait for you to use either one of these abilities and then play aggressive while it’s on cooldown.
champion.builds: THE BEST CHO'GATH BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Cho'Gath Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Axiom Arcanist and Celerity in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Move Speed in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Hextech Rocketbelt as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Riftmaker. For your last 3 items, you should build Unending Despair, Jak'Sho, The Protean and finish with Thornmail. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 55.8% winrate over 1 489 matches played. Optional Your second option for Cho'Gath Mid build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Cheap Shot with Ultimate Hunter in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Hextech Rocketbelt, which you should build first, followed by Mercury's Treads as your second item and Riftmaker as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Unending Despair, Thornmail and Cryptbloom. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 47.4% win rate over 234 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Arcane Comet as your keystone, Axiom Arcanist, Transcendence and Gathering Storm in the primary tree, and Triumph with Legend: Haste in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Rod of Ages as your first item, then Mercury's Treads as a second item and Riftmaker as a third item. You want to finish the build with Unending Despair, Thornmail and Hextech Rocketbelt. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 60.7% win rate across 178 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Cho'Gath Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Grasp of the Undying, Demolish, Conditioning and Overgrowth as your primary rune tree, and Approach Velocity with Magical Footwear as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Health Scaling and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Heartsteel as your first item, then finish Mercury's Treads as your second item, and Hollow Radiance as third item. The last 3 options are Unending Despair, Thornmail and Randuin's Omen. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 51.3% win rate over 113 matches played. Situational Cho'Gath Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Cho'Gath build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Cho'Gath runes page.
